messages:
support-liz: Multiple customers reporting sudden p95/p99 tail latency from hosted API in us-east-1 starting ~07:42 UTC. Normal p95 ~120ms -> observed ~1.35s, p99 ~3.9s->4.8s. No 5xx, requests eventually succeed but tails are bad.

support-liz: Example repro from one customer:
1) POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
2) Authorization: Bearer <redacted>, Content-Type: application/json
3) body: { "model": "redwood-large", "input": "<~900 token doc>" }
4) 30-50 concurrent connections from us-east
Observed: ~25% responses >2s, delayed queued starts.

deploy-bot: Rollout 2026-03-15T07:32:18Z by @eng-releases (sha: af9c2d) to north-us completed (feature flag: runtime.dynamic_batching_v2).

oncall-rita: Pulling traces and infra metrics. RUM shows queuing time increasing inside runtime request queues immediately after deploy. Request QPS steady.

infra-sam: GPU utilization on several serving pods is lower than baseline while CPU on control/proxy nodes spiked. That suggests larger batches waiting for coalescing but underfilled, causing head-of-line delays. Also seeing KV cache miss increase (+22%).

oncall-rita: PromQL I ran for quick signal:
- p95: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate",region="us-east-1"}[5m])) by (le))
- runtime queue ms: avg_over_time(runtime_queue_ms{region="us-east-1"}[5m])
- kv miss rate: sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total{region="us-east-1"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_request_total{region="us-east-1"}[5m]))

ml-mei: The change widened batch windows adaptively (dynamic_batching_v2). On low-concurrency single-connection patterns it can increase latency because it waits to form a fuller batch. Possible tuning regression in backoff logic.

aaron-ops: Agreed. We should treat this as a runtime heuristic regression. Short-term mitigations to apply in order of least disruption:
- 1) Flip runtime.dynamic_batching_v2=false for north-us (canary -> ramp)
- 2) Set runtime.max_batch_wait_ms=25 to limit queuing
- 3) Apply tenant-level circuit breakers: `runtime.circuit.max_queue_ms=500`
- 4) Route affected hosted traffic to fallback smaller quantized variant `redwood-large-quant-2` for customers with high p99
- 5) If needed, temporarily increase serving nodes in us-east by +2 and pre-warm cache

oncall-rita: Executing canary: `rdctl set-config runtime.dynamic_batching_v2=false --scope north-us --canary 0.05`

deploy-bot: Config change applied (canary 5%).

oncall-rita: Canary metrics after 7 minutes: canary pods p95 improved 1.3s -> 210ms, p99 4.8s -> 620ms. KV cache miss dropped ~30% on canary. Good signal.

sre-kim: Nice. Let's also add an automated circuit breaker per-tenant to avoid noisy neighbors: `rdctl set-config runtime.per_tenant_circuit.enabled=true; runtime.per_tenant_circuit.threshold_p99_ms=1500`. That'll protect other tenants while we roll.

maria-support: Telling customers: "We've identified a runtime batching heuristic introduced in a deploy; we're rolling it back in canary and enabling fallbacks. ETA ~25-40 minutes. We'll provide request-id correlation if you share example IDs."

oncall-rita: Ramping canary to 40% now. Monitoring aggregated region metrics.

oncall-rita: At 40% aggregated p95 fell to ~240ms, p99 ~700ms. Starting regional full rollback.

deploy-bot: Config update: runtime.dynamic_batching_v2=false rolled to 100% north-us by @oncall-rita at 08:12 UTC.

oncall-rita: Also applied these guard mitigations: 
- `rdctl set-config runtime.max_batch_wait_ms=25 --scope north-us`
- `rdctl set-config runtime.circuit.max_queue_ms=500 --scope north-us`
- Enabled fallback routing for hosted: map users from north-us to model `redwood-large-quant-2` if request latency exceeds p99 threshold (temporary).

infra-sam: Added 1 extra serving worker in us-east and primed KV cache for fallback variant. `infra scale workers --region us-east-1 --count +1 --reason "tail latency mitigation"`

support-liz: Customer updates: multiple customers confirm observably improved latency. One tenant reported p99 spikes still at ~1.2s for heavy single-connection tests; we enabled per-tenant breaker and fallback for them.

oncall-rita: Post-rollback metrics (08:30 UTC): region p95 ~130ms, p99 ~420ms. KV cache miss back to baseline. Marking mitigated and keeping heightened monitoring for 24h.

ml-mei: Follow-ups / action items for postmortem and runbook changes:
- Create postmortem for dynamic_batching_v2 rollout with bench harness that reproduces single-connection prefix-heavy traffic and KV patterns. Include microbench for batch wait tradeoffs.
- CI canary assertion: reject rollout if canary p99 > baseline * 1.8 after 10m.
- SLO guardrail: auto-toggle flag rollback when region p99 breaches baseline*2 for 10m with exponential backoff for retries.
- Add early-warning alert on KV cache miss rate > 12% (promql snippet to add to alerts).
- Add per-tenant rate limit / circuit breaker templates to runbook (commands + suggested thresholds).

sre-kim: Runbook improvements to add now:
- Quick kill commands: `rdctl set-config runtime.dynamic_batching_v2=false --scope <region> --canary <pct>` and `rdctl set-config runtime.circuit.max_queue_ms=<ms> --scope <region>`
- Playbook order for runtime tail regressions: 1) canary flip flag -> 2) apply per-tenant circuit breaker -> 3) enable model fallback -> 4) reduce max batch wait -> 5) scale-up workers -> 6) rollback deploy if no improvement
- Add templated customer communication snippets and case-tracker labels.

aaron-ops: Also propose a new SLO guard: when a new batching heuristic is enabled, automatically deploy a short synthetic traffic experiment that simulates single-conn low-QPS patterns for 15 minutes and compare p99. Prevent rollout if regression observed.

maria-support: I'll send customers the interim summary and promise to attach the postmortem when ready. Requesting request IDs and any reproduction logs.

oncall-rita: Anything else before we close? If not I'll update the incident channel with the runbook summary and close the thread once postmortem link is posted.

support-liz: All good from support. Closing the escalation once postmortem link in. :white_check_mark:

#participants: oncall-rita, support-liz, infra-sam, ml-mei, deploy-bot, sre-kim, aaron-ops, maria-support
